messages:
maria g.: Quick sync 1: final SEO handoff for the webinar + benchmark post going live Tue. Need clear owners for: redirects/canonicals, keyword anchors & metas, schema snippets, internal links, and inbound routing. Whos on what?
raj: Ill take keywords & meta copy. Will produce two A/B meta options and a keyword-to-anchor map by EOD.
becca: Ill own redirects & canonicals. Plan: canonicalize all variant posts to webinar landing, 301 old blog URLs to /resources/ or landing to preserve link equity.
seo-bot: quick scan: 9 pages with overlapping titles for "inference costs" terms. Recommend canonical to /events/webinar-apr-2026 and 301s for stale drafts.
ellie: can you post redirect sample format for eng? they want CSV or netlify style.
becca: sample netlify/_redirects lines (eng likes this):
```
/old-benchmark-v1    301    /resources/benchmark-2026
/blog/webinar-preview-old   301    /events/webinar-apr-2026
/docs/serving-notes-rt    301    /docs/serving-runtime
```
raj: Keyword clusters (short):
- inference cost reduction (primary)
- low-latency LLM serving
- private LLM deployment
Anchors recommended: "inference cost", "low-latency serving", "private deployment options". Use natural anchor text, limit exact-match to one link per page.
tom (growth): Routing checklist:
- landing form -> Pardot webhook (tag: rw-webinar-apr-2026)
- UTM: utm_source=newsletter, utm_medium=email, utm_campaign=rw-webinar-apr-2026
- form fields: first_name, last_name, email, company, role, intent
- webhook -> Pardot list rw-webinar-2026, thank-you triggers zapier zap-88 for SFDC lead create
maria g.: Important: do not change URLs that have high external backlinks without manual review. Becca flag those in the PR.
seo-bot: Suggested JSON-LD for event (paste into head):
```
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference: Serving LLMs in Production","startDate":"2026-04-07T17:00:00Z","endDate":"2026-04-07T18:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://www.redwood.inference/events/webinar-apr-2026"},"organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}}
```
seo-bot: also recommend a short FAQ schema for the benchmark post (2 Qs) to help rich snippets.
ellie: Ill pull GA4 pages with >250 sessions and add to internal linking sheet. We should add contextual links from product docs + benchmarks to the landing and benchmark post.
becca: Redirect PR plan: include CSV mapping, netlify/_redirects, tests on staging, manual backlink review for flagged URLs, rollback instructions. ETA PR tomorrow morning.
eng-bot: reminder: staging deploy will run crawl after PR merge. Use staging-searchbot to validate canonical tags and 301s.
raj: meta descriptions: posting two concise variants in the doc now. One focused on "inference cost" and one on "low-latency serving".
tom (growth): added the form field mapping and webhook example to Notion. Ping me if you need test webhook creds.
maria g.: Prioritization: 1) redirects/canonicals (becca) 2) routing/form & UTMs (tom) 3) keywords & metas (raj) 4) schema (seo-bot) 5) internal linking list (ellie). Reconvene tomorrow 10am PT to review PR + handoff. :thumbsup:
seo-bot: post-merge checklist: run staging crawl, verify canonical headers, check Search Console for new 301s, monitor impressions for title/description change.
ellie: got it. Ill send the internal link sheet before EOD and flag priority pages.
